action: Works on copies named Body.001, Hair1.001, Hair2.001; in Edit Mode, front ortho, selects the sleeves/arms and rotates them up into a T-pose.
view: 3D Viewport Edit Mode, Front Orthographic, Image Editor with reference on the left
why: Mixamo auto-rigging works best with arms out in a T-pose
reader_equivalent: Select arm verts, bpy.ops.transform.rotate(value=..., orient_axis='Y') around the shoulder pivot

action: Checks the textured T-pose character in Object Mode, front orthographic.
reader_equivalent: Render a front orthographic view and compare to the reference

action: In Mixamo the uploaded character FEMALE_CHAR1 is processing in the Auto-Rigger ('Processing upload').
why: Get an automatic skeleton and skin weights
reader_equivalent: manual web step: upload the exported FBX at mixamo.com > Upload Character (needs an Adobe sign-in)

action: Mixamo runs 'Auto-Rigging...' then shows the Review screen with the rigged character; artist presses Next.
reader_equivalent: manual web step: wait for the rig, check the review preview, click Next

action: Searches animations for 'run', picks Running, and downloads it with In Place checked.
why: Get a run cycle that stays at the origin for game movement
reader_equivalent: manual web step: search 'run', choose Running, tick In Place, Download

action: Searches 'idle', previews several idles, and downloads Dwarf Idle.
reader_equivalent: manual web step: search 'idle', choose Dwarf Idle, Download

action: Imports the Mixamo FBX into a fresh Blender scene: an Armature with Animation and Pose children plus Body.001, Hair1.001, Hair2.001 parented under it.
why: Bring the rigged, animated character back into Blender

action: In the Shading workspace adds an Image Texture node to Hair2.001's material (Shader) and opens the texture file into it, wiring it to the Principled BSDF.
why: The imported FBX came back without the texture linked
reader_equivalent: tex = nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexImage'); tex.image = bpy.data.images.load(path); links.new(tex.outputs['Color'], bsdf.inputs['Base Color'])

action: Shows the textured character in Object Mode after the texture is relinked.
why: Check the texture is back on all parts
reader_equivalent: Render a preview and compare colours to the reference

action: In the Animation workspace selects the Armature in Pose Mode and checks the Idle action in the Action Editor (mixamorig bone channels), setting the end frame.
why: Verify the downloaded animation plays and fix the frame range

action: Exports FBX into the Godot project folder (folders .godot, Asset, Scene) with all object types and default transform options.

settings.object_types: Empty, Camera, Lamp, Armature, Mesh, Other (all on)

why: Send the rigged, animated character to Godot
reader_equivalent: bpy.ops.export_scene.fbx(filepath=..., path_mode='AUTO', object_types={...all}, global_scale=1.0, apply_scale_options='FBX_SCALE_NONE', axis_forward='-Z', axis_up='Y')
